name: BSD — Business Scene Dialogue en↔ja (test)
description: BSD (Business Scene Dialogue) — the held-out test split of the English↔Japanese business-conversation benchmark: 69 dialogue scenarios (meetings, phone calls, presentations; half written in en, half in ja, professionally translated), flattened to 2,120 sentence-pair turns in document order. Both directions scored. Document-level context is preserved in order but not yet exploited by the harness (see card notes). Fetched on demand from the pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain: conv (business dialogue). Contamination HIGH — public since 2020, in frontier-model crawls — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (verified at the pin) → non-commercial lanes only; cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24 into the NC research lane: benchmarkable; never in a commercial, prize, or API lane; remote evaluation only over no-train channels.
